title: triticum loliaceum
intro: Triticum loliaceum, commonly known as "loli" or "wild emmer," is an annual grass species within the wheat family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Triticum loliaceum include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Triticum loliaceum include phenolic compounds, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable subject for further research.
